measurement_scope: On-screen DRAW counts completed present-submission calls per wall-clock interval; SIM counts simulation ticks. GIF rate is capture rate. GPU execution time and physical presentation are not measured.
source_size: actual client size; see window_width/window_height in CSV
solver: Eulerian MAC / geometric VOF, cut-cell pressure, MIC-PCG
checks: concave domain with an internal baffle
real rendered water beyond the baffle

headless_replay.scope: Headless authoritative replay; includes all game updates, snapshots, paused input ticks and checksum verification. No graphics. This is an average bound, not a worst-case frame time.

rendered_liquid_regions.scope: Water-color cell-center probes inside the basin; rendered topology, not a measurement of phase volume.
